result.question: What do Dan people want Levite to ask God?

readings.answer: whether they will have a successful journey
readings.support: whether we will have a successful journey

assessments.reason: The passage says, “Please inquire of God to determine whether we will have a successful journey,” which is equivalent to asking if they would succeed.
